definition: אַקּוֺ noun masculine wild goat (?) only Deut 14:5 in list of clean animals וָזָ֑מֶר אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֺ וְדִישׁוֺן וּתְאוֺ ( ᵐ5 ὄρυξ , ᵑ6 ᵑ7 ibex ; compare Bo Hieroz. i. 900 f. , Thes below אנק compare MV , with reference to Arabic goat ; Thes compare also Talmud אִיקָא , but NHWB MV refer this to αἴξ ). אֹר see אוֺר , for Amos Deut 8:8 see יְאֹר .

BDB707 [H689]

BDB706 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB708

אַקּוֺ noun masculine wild goat (?) only Deut 14:5 in list of clean animals וָזָ֑מֶר אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֺ וְדִישׁוֺן וּתְאוֺ (ᵐ5 ὄρυξ, ᵑ6 ᵑ7 ibex; compare BoHieroz. i. 900 f., Thes below אנק compare MV, with reference to Arabic goat; Thes compare also Talmud אִיקָא, but NHWB MV refer this to αἴξ).

אֹר see אוֺר, for Amos Deut 8:8 see יְאֹר.

hebrew: וָזָ֑מֶר אַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וְאַקּוֺ וְדִישׁוֺן וּתְאוֺ
